messages.subject: Buildtemplate outlier in CVA/PCA analyses
parts:
Hello everyone, I have used the buildtemplate and digitsurface function to digitize landmarks on micro-ct scans. 
The problem is that which ever mesh I use for template, the particular specimen appears as an outlier in the PCA/CVA analyses..
Do you have any idea why this is happening? Maybe I should not include the template's nts file when I ran the analysis?
